attributes.description:
ExcerLock helps you reduce distracting app use by making movement part of your Screen Time routine.

Choose apps with Apple's Family Controls picker, set your rules, and use walking or a gym visit to satisfy the conditions you configure. ExcerLock uses Apple's Screen Time frameworks to apply shields to the apps you select.

HOW IT WORKS
• Choose the apps you want ExcerLock to manage
• Create a walking or gym condition
• Complete your condition to unlock according to your rule
• Review status and adjust preferences from the app

BUILT AROUND YOUR CHOICES
You decide which apps are selected and which movement conditions to use. Screen Time authorization can be revoked in iOS Settings, and ExcerLock shows recovery guidance when permission or setup is incomplete.

ACCOUNT AND SUBSCRIPTIONS
You can begin with an anonymous account and link your identity using a supported sign-in method. Premium access is offered as an auto-renewable subscription. Pricing and renewal terms are shown before purchase; purchases can be restored from Settings.

PRIVACY
Health, motion, selected-app tokens, and gym-location signals used for condition verification are processed on device. Optional analytics can be disabled. Account deletion, data export, support, Terms of Use, and the Privacy Policy are available from Settings.

Walking and gym detection require a compatible iPhone and the permissions needed for the condition you choose. ExcerLock is a self-control tool for managing your own device; it is not a parental-control or medical app.
attributes.promotionalText: Choose distracting apps, complete a walking or gym condition, and unlock according to rules you control.
